Apex Learning was acquired by Edmentum in 2021 and its courses now sit on Edmentum's platform, so the current legal entity, website and contact details could not be confirmed as Apex Learning, Inc. itself

profile.summary: Apex Learning is a Seattle-based provider of digital curriculum for grades 6-12, offering credit-bearing core and elective courses, technology courses and tutorials. It was acquired by Edmentum, an education technology company, in 2021, and Apex Courses are now offered through Edmentum.
